claims.statement: Configured exact-match controls do not eliminate all duplicate payments: CBSA found two genuine duplicate pairs in a ten-pair targeted sample despite built-in system prompts.
A high-volume buyer with internal controls purchased an external recovery review; the provider analyzed 645,000 transactions, verified 82 exceptions and recovered a six-figure sum.
Recovery delivery includes analysis, statement review, human verification and recovery work; it is not merely an automated artifact.
A published commercial benchmark prices end-to-end duplicate-payment recovery at 25% standard and 12.5% minimum of recovered value.
SAP and Microsoft already provide configurable supplier-invoice similarity and invoice/receipt/price matching, making generic anomaly detection vulnerable to bundling.
Recovery authority remains with the buyer: guidance treats consultants as acting on the retailer's behalf and requires finance-team scrutiny and express settlement agreement.
The contingency model creates a documented incentive risk toward maximizing claim volume or value, making explainability and customer approval necessary controls.
A four-year GBP 141,600 award for software processing about 250,000 invoices annually across several entities establishes budget at high volume but not the proposed Polish SME price.
Poland's 17,601 active medium enterprises are only a broad ceiling; invoice volume, systems complexity and recoverable leakage are absent from the statistic.
Processing invoice data on behalf of a customer requires a documented processor relationship and safeguards wherever personal data is included.
Polish law recognizes claims for undue performance but lists exceptions, so a detected duplicate is not equivalent to immediately recoverable cash.
The recoverable-error rate and contribution margin for Polish firms with several thousand annual invoices are unknown.
Accounting-firm and ERP-implementer willingness to resell, channel CAC and audit-to-monitoring conversion are unknown.

contrary_evidence: Incumbent ERPs already implement configurable matching and fuzzy duplicate controls.
The best quantified recovery example is a very high-volume NHS buyer, not a Polish mid-market firm.
Official guidance documents incentive and supplier-fairness problems in contingency recovery audits.
The observed monitoring-software award is shared across public entities and does not validate per-SME pricing.
